parts.name: green body shell

physics.Basic_description: The main teal-colored structural frame comprising the fuel tank base and the top burner assembly housing.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the fuel reservoir at the bottom and supports the chimney and globe assembly at the top.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the cylindrical base or the upper collar firmly to lift or stabilize the lantern.
physics.reason: Standard lantern construction uses thin stamped sheet metal for the body to minimize weight while containing fuel/air.

parts.description: The main teal-colored structural frame comprising the fuel tank base and the top burner assembly housing.

parts.name: globe glass

physics.Basic_description: A translucent, frosted white glass cylinder situated in the center of the lantern.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the flame from wind and diffuses the light output.
physics.Grasped_description: Avoid grasping; the glass is fragile and smooth, offering poor friction for lifting the heavy object.
physics.reason: Glass globes are thin-walled vessels enclosing air volume around the flame.

parts.description: A translucent, frosted white glass cylinder situated in the center of the lantern.

physics.reason: These are solid metal rods or thick stamped slats, not hollow shells.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
